summary: Reliable Accountants (Reliable Melbourne Accountants) is a Port Melbourne tax, GST and bookkeeping practice led by Director Tushar Khanna CA, who is still listed as Director. The firm works in Xero, MYOB and QuickBooks, hired a tax accountant in August 2025 whose duties include BAS, IAS and payroll tax lodgements, and was named Top Accountant in Melbourne 2025 by Just Melbourne. Already emailed once on 23 Nov 2026; follow-ups use new angles.

hooks.text: Tushar's Aug 2025 hiring post: the new tax accountant does BAS, IAS, payroll tax and workers' comp reconciliations, so routine prep work is a capacity constraint.
Top Accountant in Melbourne 2025 ranking, a recent public win Tushar chose to post.
Firm blog already endorses intelligent reconciliation tools, so the idea is not foreign to them.

risks.text: The firm is tax-led; bookkeeping is one service among several. LinkedIn headcount (about 20) conflicts with the 33 in the account record, and part of the team is offshore.
The email on file is a pattern guess from Clay, not verified.

gaps: No podcast, video, Facebook or Instagram content found for the firm or Tushar.
No evidence of a specific AI reconciliation tool in use (Dext, Hubdoc etc.).
Accounts record says the firm 'talks about automating data'; only blog posts support it, none recent beyond Nov 2024.
The text of the first email sent on 23 Nov 2026 is not available; follow-ups avoid repeating specifics.
